create_contact_qr_code.description: Turn someone's contact details into a designed QR code that a phone offers to save straight to its address book. The one to put on a business card, an email signature or a conference badge, styled to match your brand. No account or API key required.
create_contact_qr_code.display_str_template: Create a designed contact QR code for {0}.

mock_response.encoded_text:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
ORG:Acme
TEL;TYPE=CELL:+1 555 0100
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET:jane@acme.example
END:VCARD

create_contact_qr_code.name: create_contact_qr_code

parameters.description: The person's name, as it should be saved.
parameters.name: full_name

parameters.description: Optional. Where they work.
parameters.name: organization

parameters.description: Optional. Their role.
parameters.name: job_title

parameters.description: Optional. Include the country code so the number dials from anywhere.
parameters.name: phone

parameters.description: Optional. Their email address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Optional. A web address to save with the contact.
parameters.name: website

parameters.description: Optional. A postal address, written as one line.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: The shape of the small squares that make up the code. Every pattern scans; pick the one that suits the design.
parameters.name: body_shape

parameters.description: The shape of the outer ring of the three large squares in the code's corners.
parameters.name: eye_frame

parameters.description: The shape of the solid centre of the three large squares in the code's corners.
parameters.name: eye_ball

parameters.description: The colour of the code, as a hex colour. It has to be clearly darker than the background or scanners will not read it.
parameters.name: code_color

parameters.description: The colour behind the code, as a hex colour. Keep it light so the code stands out.
parameters.name: background_color

parameters.description: Optional. A different colour for the three large corner squares, as a hex colour. Leave blank to use the code colour.
parameters.name: corner_color

parameters.description: Fade the code from the code colour into a second colour, either across the code or from its centre outwards.

description: Make QR codes that look like part of your brand, with QRCode Monkey. Put a link or any text into a code, or build the ones people actually need: a Wi-Fi code that joins the network when a guest scans it, a contact code a phone saves to its address book, an event code it adds to a calendar. Choose dots, rounded or other patterns, shaped corners, your own colours or a gradient, and put your logo in the middle. Get a PNG for the web, or SVG, PDF or EPS for print. No account or API key required.
